checks.name: Embedded release assets match the candidate source, without CSS or JS overrides
Local bootstrap exposes only a canonical PC address and static roots preserve fragments
Missing, foreign or duplicate origins and form/navigation requests never open a browser
Proxy, foreign host and Fetch Metadata variants cannot spend the opener budget
Allowed opening uses only the generated private link and never signs in its caller
A hung OS opener is killed within its deadline and concurrent requests stay bounded
A new plain localhost tab reaches a compact welcome with one usable Open editor action
Opener success cannot claim authentication; a different profile exposes bounded fallback
Another tab using the opened private link makes the original tab usable without copied secrets
An authenticated localhost alias remains on its original origin and reuses its host cookie
A stored pending draft prevents fresh-entry normalization from abandoning its localhost origin
Loaded unacknowledged source survives lost cookies and local browser reopening without an origin hop
An older real unauthenticated bootstrap cannot repaint welcome after private-link authentication
A foreign local web page cannot trigger the opener through fetch, forms or preflight
A failed OS opener gives a visible recovery path without granting access
A localhost invitation retains its origin and never exposes the PC opener
No browser exceptions or credential disclosure occurred in the reviewed workflows

limits: OS default-browser integration is emulated with an actual fake opener executable and real browser private-link navigation.
Physical devices and real platform browser handlers remain untested.
Existing browser profiles, credentials, user projects and live Relay hosts are never accessed.

pieces.evidence: One prominent Open editor action replaces the blocking paste-only modal. The editor appears only after real cookie authentication and WebSocket connection.

Origin/Host/loopback/proxy/Fetch Metadata matrix denies attackers; successful opener responses disclose no credential and do not authenticate their caller. Hung children terminate within the opener deadline.
Authenticated aliases, stored pending drafts and loaded unacknowledged source retain their original origin. An older real 401 response cannot replace authenticated UI.
Actual 320×300 native-wheel scrolling reaches a fully visible, hit-tested Continue here target at least 44 px high. The previous release had no usable scroll range.
Origin-bound localhost invitations retain their origin, show the PIN flow and never expose the local PC opener.
Actual final welcome, expanded fallback, recovered draft and invitation screenshots compared with the retained baseline. Quiet typography and one primary action clarify the next step.

rejectedRound.issue: Expanded fallback exceeded the locked 300 px viewport with zero scroll range in both engines. The final release bounds the welcome to the visual viewport and provides a real scrollport.

manualReview.comparisonMethod: Independent recognizable task/security and screenshot comparison; no true blind study or ASVS certification.
manualReview.biggestRemainingGap: Real operating-system default-browser handlers and physical devices were not exercised; a fake executable models dispatch while real browser contexts exercise the generated private link, cookie and WebSocket exchange.
